evidence: src/infrastructure/in-memory-order-repository.ts: class InMemoryOrderRepository implements OrderRepository. It is a persistence adapter for a port defined in the domain.
save(order) only calls this.orders.set(order.id, order). This is pure storage with no validation or business decisions.
findById(id) only calls this.orders.get(id). This is a plain lookup.
listByState(state?) filters stored orders by order.state === state. This is a query criterion, not a domain rule.
parsedVerdict.reasoning: The file is a plain persistence adapter for the infrastructure layer. InMemoryOrderRepository implements the domain-owned OrderRepository port. It uses a Map to provide storage (save), lookup (findById) and a query (listByState). The state filter in listByState is a storage query criterion, not a business rule: it makes no decisions about order lifecycle, validation, pricing or allowed transitions. The file contains no transport, presentation or domain logic. Every responsibility fits the infrastructure layer kind.
